name: @block-genomics/monorepo-root
description: Monorepo root for the Block Genomics Nexus tree. This package is intentionally not publishable — the shippable packages live under cli/, packages/, sdk/, and app/.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo '\n[block-genomics] refusing to publish the monorepo root. Publish the individual package under cli/, packages/*, or sdk/* instead.\n' && exit 1
